_README: Per-article subject descriptions for article-page hero images. The script (generate-article-heroes.mjs) wraps each 'subject' in a shared photoreal 16:9 scene template. Slugs match the article HTML filenames. IP rule: pages about copyrighted characters or real people (Bluey, Cinnamoroll, MHA, Heartopia, Froplay, Elvis, Lewis Hamilton, Indy/Good Boy) get a REAL-dog stand-in scene, never the character or person. Add new slugs here when new article pages are written.
